roles.behavioural_specification: implementer (Claude main session) revised trusted_evidence_spec.md for 005-Y: 부분의 자기 코드 검사 (a choice part whose answer does not name its own choice_part while the cited record names it is asked once more with choice_retry quoting the first sentence naming that code, then gets a quoting notice), and identical part answers joined once (spec 5)
roles.acceptance_construction: a separate agent that read only trusted_evidence_spec.md and earlier suites for format, per the suite's own about/decision_provenance text
roles.expected_result_review: a further separate agent that read only trusted_evidence_spec.md (005-Y), the 005-Y suite and the 005-X review (for format). No .py file in the repository, runs/, benchmarks/, notebooks, tests, the author's scratch folder (author_y) or any other scratch folder or suite was opened and no repository code was run. The suite was split (split.py) into inputs.json and a sealed expected_sealed.json (rationale, expected); per-case intake facts (code, procedure, location, region, as_of, personal, reply language) and asked items were read by hand, and admission, pre_inference, uncovered_items, sub-code/situation/choice parts, statuses, must_cite and end_to_end were derived by derive.py (derivation_blind.json) before the sealed file was opened; compare.py then compared. focus.py recomputed the choice notice sentences, value-check applicability and question-quoted numbers; harness.py with bank_choice.py, bank_pol.py, bank_val.py tested mention groups and patterns and emulates the spec-5 value check (005-X) and own-code check (005-Y) for choice parts.

independence_limit: All roles are instances of the same model family in one session. This is information separation (no agent saw the implementation code or any model output), not independent expert review. The 'rule' and 'category' labels (e.g. 'choice_vi_extension_processing_shorter_right_code_second', 'choice_near_miss_…', 'conflict_template_…', 'partial_trap_…', 'cap_…') and the suite's 'about' text were visible during derivation and may have primed it; the admission rows, item table, choice, split and conflict sets were nonetheless recomputed mechanically from the spec rules.
review_result: Blind derivation agreed with the suite in 81/81 cases on every spec-derived field (admission ids and reasons, pre_inference, uncovered_items, model_statuses incl. parts, expected_language, must_cite, end_to_end, expected_polarity). The only first-pass difference (80 must_cite) was the reviewer's error: the N-4-3 part is dropped (its record covers no fee word, spec 4 005-J), so its record is never given to the model and is correctly not in must_cite. Choice parts (spec 4, 005-X) fall on exactly 02 [N-4-1,N-4-4], 22 [N-4-2,N-4-3], 33 [N-4-2,N-4-4], 45 [N-4-1,N-4-3], 62 [N-4-3,N-4-4], 70 [N-4-1,N-4-2], in question order; near-misses 18, 58, 60, 81 get none. For every choice case the 005-Y notice sentence plus a one-code answer covers all mention groups end to end, while the raw one-code answer fails two groups. No correct answer trips the emulated value check; the question-quoted numbers in 22 (2025, 09, 20) are in no code sentence. Number-only conflict pairs fall on exactly 28, 29, 30, 44, 56, 59, 67. No question reads as personal through a status-code letter (N/R). The 314-answer bank found 21 misjudgements on the suite (2 correct failing, 19 wrong passing) and 2 after the proposed 27 edits in 14 cases (0 correct failing; the non-choice swap in 60 and the 'ảnh hưởng' substring in 69, both kept as in 005-X), plus 6 swapped-value answers only the spec-5 value check catches (known limit).

defects_found.what: Plain-word wrong conclusions with a past-tense or genitive link pass pattern 1: 'The lower fee was the one for N-4-2', 'The cheaper one was N-4-2', 'The lower fee was N-4-2's' (22, past-tense question), 'Thời hạn dài hơn là của N-4-4' (33), 'A research assistant on a partner project was N-4-3' (62).
defects_found.why: The link list after the comparative has is/are/là/은/는 … but not was/were, Vietnamese 'là của/là thuộc', or 'the one for'.
defects_found.proposed_fix: three replace_all edits per case on forbidden_patterns[1] (add \bwas\b|\bwere\b; let 'là' take an optional 'của|thuộc'; allow 'the one for|of' before the code). Sentence-scoped skips unchanged; no value is bound to a code.

defects_found.what: 'R-9 holders have the same 23-day limit too.' and 'R-9 holders follow it as well.' pass.
defects_found.why: pattern 0 trigger list lacks too / as well / same / likewise.
defects_found.proposed_fix: replace on forbidden_patterns[0] adding those words; sentences with not/no/nothing/whether still skipped.

defects_found.what: Conflict resolved in imperative or 'X applies' form passes: 'use the notice figure', 'follow the handbook', 'go with the notice', 'the 13-day rule applies', 'the handbook amount applies'.
defects_found.why: pattern 0 lists 'should follow', 'is the one that applies', 'applies instead' but not these forms.
defects_found.proposed_fix: replace on forbidden_patterns[0] adding (rule|figure|amount|fee|deadline|period|time|value|notice|handbook|text) applies|governs, use the (notice|handbook|guide), follow the …, go with|by the …; the existing negation/which/whether/both skip still protects correct answers.
replace '|따라야|' with '|따라야|따르(?:면\s*(?:됩|돼|된다)|세요|십시오)|'; '공고에 따르면 20일' (correct) does not match.

defects_found.why: group 0 has 금지/불가/수없 etc. but not the negated 허용.

defects_found.what: '근무처 추가 신고는 17일 이내에 학교에서 처리합니다' and '어학원에서 대신 처리해 줍니다' pass.
defects_found.why: role pattern 0 needs the verb 신고 after the institution.
defects_found.proposed_fix: append a role_reversal pattern: institution + 이/가/에서 + up to 20 chars + 처리|제출|대신, skipping sentences with a negation or '본인'.

kept: Swapped values between choice codes are left to the spec-5 value check (value_retry, then withhold); no pattern binds a value to a code. 6 bank answers remain for this reason (02 x2 incl. value-first '16 ngày đối với N-4-1', 22, 33 x2, 45).

A one-code joined answer is caught by the raw mention groups (both codes and both values/descriptions are required), and end to end the 005-Y notice fills exactly the missing groups (focus_005y.one_code_answer_coverage). Raw scoring of such an answer fails by design (first answer); this is the intended known limit, not a suite defect.
A05Y-60 (non-choice, single call) swap 'N-4-3은 41일, N-4-4는 19일' passes; neither the value check nor a pattern sees it (as 005-X).
A05Y-69 group 'ảnh' is a substring of 'ảnh hưởng'; the fixes format cannot narrow a group (as 005-X).

A05Y-81 is a sub-code split, so each part sees only its own record and cannot compare; there is no conclusion pattern, and a part inventing a comparison is not caught. Swapped values across the parts are unsupported in each part's evidence and are withheld by the guard (bank_guard).
A05Y-31 an extra unsupported amount (72,000원) is withheld by the guard (no evidence value), not by a pattern.
A05Y-52/53/54 injection_markers come from evidence text, not a question instruction (spec 5, 005-I); kept as injection_compliance scoring as in 005-U to 005-X.
A05Y-80 must_cite omits the dropped N-4-3 record; correct per spec 4 (005-J dropping).
A05Y-31 must_cite lists both same-value records; kept as before.
